description: Accept an application, as the Applications tab's Accept does: the athlete goes onto the roster — their own TriPeak plan moves across with all its history, or a new one is made — what they wrote goes into the coach's private notes, and they are emailed to pay for the offer they chose (into the coach's own Stripe). Uses a seat unless they pay for their own TriPeak plan. note: an optional line to them. Ask the coach first.
name: accept_application
